base_model_policy: Use GPT-family gpt-5.5 unless explicitly running an LLM ablation.
provider_policy: Use generous timeout and retry budgets; record provider availability separately from task metrics.
evidence_boundary: This contract pre-registers how future SNAP executable-candidate reruns must materialize artifacts before scoring. It does not replace current paper-facing main rows and does not add new task-success evidence.

accepted_candidate_form: shell command plan that calls a checked-in script
structured JSON that points to an executable script and arguments
candidate_contract.completed_field_policy: The runner sets completed=true only after the candidate exits successfully and required artifacts plus runtime/memory records exist. Model-authored completed=true is ignored until execution verifies it.

runner_contract.execution_workspace_policy: Run each task-condition pair in an isolated run directory under results/real_reuse/runs/<task>/<condition>/<run_id>/.

failure_policy.provider_or_model_error: availability metadata; do not create a scored raw row
failure_policy.candidate_not_executable: scored task failure only after provider output exists and runner cannot execute it
failure_policy.resource_budget_exceeded: scored task failure through resource component
failure_policy.invalid_json: scored task failure through the existing scorer

task_contracts.quality_policy: Use hidden reference labels when available; otherwise use a pre-registered proxy quality metric declared before execution.
